notes: No secrets in this file. It is bundled into the app and is readable by anyone who installs it.
Runtime configuration comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_* variables at build time - see .env.example.
android.permissions is deliberately empty: only the minimum Expo requires is declared, which keeps the Play Data Safety surface small for a finance app.
